title: Score a bagged ensemble on the rows its trees missed
brief: Find the rows each stump never saw, average only those stumps' predictions for each row, and compute the out-of-bag error.
hints: oob_mask starts from in_bag = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool), sets in_bag[idx] = True, and returns ~in_bag. A repeated index writes the same slot twice, so you do not need np.unique.
In oob_predictions keep total and count arrays of shape (n,). For each stump, add its predictions into total[mask] and add 1 into count[mask], where mask = oob_mask(idx, n).

Divide total by count only where count > 0, and put np.nan elsewhere. In out_of_bag_error, average the squared error over the rows where count > 0, and raise ValueError when there are none. On the hand example the answer is 50.
